hint.en: Volumetric clouds at a real height. High is smoother and costs more.
hint.zh: 真实高度的体积云。高：更细腻，更吃显卡。

hint.en: Shadows of the land, buildings, railway and trains. 0 turns them off and stops drawing the shadow maps.
hint.zh: 地形、建筑、铁路、列车的影子深浅。0 关闭，也不再画阴影贴图。

hint.en: Soft shade in corners and gaps, worked out on the screen. 0 off.
hint.zh: 墙角和缝隙里的柔和暗部（按屏幕计算）。0 关闭。

hint.en: Buildings and hills mirrored in the water (from what is on the screen). 0 off.
hint.zh: 岸上的建筑和山映在水里（取自屏幕上的画面）。0 关闭。

hint.en: Bright things glow, the sun has rays. 0 off.
hint.zh: 亮处发光、太阳有光芒。0 关闭。

hint.en: Photographed materials (CC0, ambientCG) on the land, roads and buildings: grass, sand, snow, rock, asphalt, brick, plaster. 0 plain colours.
hint.zh: 地面、道路和建筑铺上照片材质（CC0，来自 ambientCG）：草地、沙、雪、岩石、沥青、砖、抹灰。0 为纯色。

name.en: Skip the game's flat map in 3D
name.zh: 三维时不画游戏的平面地图

hint.en: While the 3D land covers it, the game does not draw its map's tiles and roads (faster). Turn off if something is missing.
hint.zh: 三维地面盖住时，让游戏不画地图图块和道路（更快）。发现缺东西时关掉。

hint.en: Soft, curving borders between water, woods, fields and sand near the eye (about 1.5 ms at 4K).
hint.zh: 近处水、树林、田地、沙地之间柔和弯曲的边界（4K 下约 1.5 毫秒）。

hint.en: Buildings, roads and cars are drawn this far from the middle of the view, whatever the zoom.
hint.zh: 建筑、道路和车辆画到离视野中心多远，不随缩放变。

hint.en: How many screen pixels one texel of the ground may cover before it is refined. Higher: blurrier, cheaper.
hint.zh: 地面贴图的一个纹素在屏幕上占多少像素才细分。调大更省、更糊。

hint.en: About 1.5 MB each (160 is 240 MB). Fewer for cards with little memory.
hint.zh: 每块约 1.5 MB（160 块约 240 MB）。显存小的显卡调低。

hint.en: Trees standing in parks and woods near the eye.
hint.zh: 近处公园和林地里立着的树。

hint.en: Roads with kerbs, pavements and bridges. Off: painted on the ground only.
hint.zh: 带路缘、人行道和桥的道路。关闭则只画在地面上。

hint.en: Cars, buses and traffic lights.
hint.zh: 汽车、公交车和红绿灯。

hint.en: Cars, buses, lorries and boats near the eye drawn with their own 3D models; further off, or off, the simple shapes.
hint.zh: 近处的汽车、公交、货车和船用精细三维模型；远处或关闭时用简单形状。

hint.en: Boats on the water and their wakes.
hint.zh: 水面上的船和尾迹。

hint.en: Buildings and roads level the ground under them, with foundations showing on slopes.
hint.zh: 建筑和道路整平脚下的地形，坡上露出地基。

hint.en: Buildings from the game's map data, with windows and roofs.
hint.zh: 用游戏地图数据生成的建筑，带窗户和屋顶。

hint.en: Street lamps and train headlights lighting the ground.
hint.zh: 路灯和列车车头灯照在地上的光。

hint.en: Woods without tree models drawn as crowns seen from above; off: a flat green.
hint.zh: 没有树模型的林地画成一棵棵树冠；关闭则是平涂的绿色。

hint.en: A grain on lawns and fields.
hint.zh: 草坪和田地上的纹理。

hint.en: Tree line, alpine meadows, rock and snow by height, latitude and season.
hint.zh: 按海拔、纬度和季节画林线、高山草甸、裸岩和雪。

hint.en: Hills drawn this many times higher (Ctrl+F8).
hint.zh: 山画高几倍（Ctrl+F8）。

hint.en: Off: the ground is the game's own flat picture stretched over the land (older, blurrier).
hint.zh: 关闭则把游戏的二维画面铺在地形上（旧做法，更糊）。

hint.en: Waves, the sky mirrored and the sun's glitter.
hint.zh: 波纹、天空反射和阳光反光。

hint.en: How dark the clouds' shadows on the ground are. 0 off.
hint.zh: 云投在地上的影子有多深。0 关闭。

hint.en: Auto changes by itself. Ctrl+Shift+F8 also cycles it.
hint.zh: 自动：自己变化。也可以按 Ctrl+Shift+F8 切换。

hint.en: Light, sky, clouds and colours like an anime film. 0: plain lighting.
hint.zh: 光影、天空、云和配色。0 为普通光照。

hint.en: The map's colours shown as lawn, asphalt, woods, roofs... 0: the map's own palette.
hint.zh: 把地图颜色画成草坪、沥青、林地、屋顶等材质。0 为地图原色。

hint.en: Contrast, saturation, warm and cool tints, vignette. 0 off.
hint.zh: 对比、饱和度、冷暖色调和暗角。0 关闭。

hint.en: The 3D view drawn by an Iris/OptiFine shader pack from .minecraft\shaderpacks: off, or one of those found there (the ones known to work first). NVIDIA cards only for now; choosing one takes a few seconds.
hint.zh: 用 Iris/OptiFine 光影包画三维视图（取自 .minecraft\shaderpacks）：关，或那里找到的某一个（已知能用的排在前面）。目前只支持 NVIDIA 显卡；选中后要等几秒。

hint.en: Ballast, rails, viaducts, tunnels, platforms and signals. Off: tracks stay painted lines.
hint.zh: 道床、钢轨、高架、隧道、站台和信号机。关闭则铁路仍是画在地上的线。

hint.en: Cars with the game's liveries, doors opening at platforms.
hint.zh: 带游戏涂装的车厢，在站台开关门。

name.en: Every train, from the game's memory

hint.en: Trains outside the game's own 2D view are drawn too, where the save's track has them (read from the game's memory, never written).
hint.zh: 游戏二维视野以外的列车也画出来（只读游戏内存，从不写入；只限存档里有的轨道）。

hint.en: Trains whose mod brings 3D models (a nimby3d folder) are drawn with them. Off: every car is the generic one.
hint.zh: 模组带了三维模型（nimby3d 文件夹）的列车用这些模型画。关闭则都用通用车厢。

hint.en: Models follow the track the game is drawing now; off: only the track in the save.
hint.zh: 模型跟随游戏正在画的轨道；关闭则只用存档里的轨道。

hint.en: In 3D the game's own track drawing is lifted off the ground, so nothing shows under viaducts.
hint.zh: 三维下把游戏画的铁路从地面上拿开，高架下面不留痕迹。

hint.en: The game's signal, sign and balise icons stood up as models.
hint.zh: 游戏的信号、标志、应答器图标立成模型。

hint.en: Red, yellow or green by where the trains are (the add-on's own guess, not the game's paths).
hint.zh: 按列车位置亮红、黄、绿（插件自己估的，不是游戏的进路）。

hint.en: Name boards, benches, lamps and stairs on platforms.
hint.zh: 站台上的站名牌、长椅、灯和楼梯间。

hint.en: Tunnels and what is in them seen through the ground (Shift+F8).
hint.zh: 透过地面看到隧道和里面的东西（Shift+F8）。

hint.en: Station and train names standing up, lying on the ground, or not shown.
hint.zh: 站名和车牌立起来、铺在地面上，或者不显示。

hint.en: Tracks as wide as the game paints them when zoomed out; off: true width.
hint.zh: 拉远时轨道和游戏画的线一样宽；关闭为真实宽度。

hint.en: A magenta square on every station of the save (Ctrl+F9).
hint.zh: 存档里每个车站一个洋红方块（Ctrl+F9）。

name.zh: 车站建在统一的地基上

hint.en: The track of a station on the ground is levelled to one height (the highest land under its platforms), on a concrete slab walled round; the line ramps up to it.
hint.zh: 地面车站的轨道统一到同一个高度（站台下最高处的地面），下面是一圈挡墙围着的混凝土平台，线路以坡道接上来。

name.en: Towers over the track on columns
name.zh: 铁路上方的高楼立柱架起

hint.en: A tall building standing over your track is lifted onto a deck on columns between the tracks (only where enough columns fit). Off: it is cut back to clear the track like any other.
hint.zh: 压在你铁路上的高楼抬到轨道之间立柱撑起的平台上（只在柱子够的地方）。关闭则和别的楼一样按铁路净空裁掉。

hint.en: A footbridge across the platforms of a station, clear of the trains, with a railed stair down to each platform.
hint.zh: 横跨同一车站各站台的人行天桥（在列车上方），每个站台一段带栏杆的楼梯。

hint.en: As the setting above for all stations, or otherwise for this one.
hint.zh: 跟随上面对所有车站的设置，或者单独给这个车站设。

hint.en: Above its foundation's level (with the foundation on): an elevated station, its line ramping up to it.
hint.zh: 在地基高度上再抬高（地基开着时）：做成高架车站，线路以坡道上去。

hint.en: Stand on the ground in the middle of the view and look about, up at the sky too: drag with the middle button to look, the pan keys to walk (the game's zoom sets the pace).
hint.zh: 站在视野中心的地面上环顾四周，也能抬头看天：按住中键拖动转头，平移键走路（游戏的缩放决定走多快）。

hint.en: 1.7 m standing on the street; higher for the view from a roof or a drone.
hint.zh: 站在街上 1.7 米；调高就是从楼顶或无人机上看。

name.zh: 第三人称：看到自己（C 键）

hint.en: In the first person, the camera stands behind your figure (nimby3d_avatar.vrm beside the add-on, a VRM model of your own). C or Shift+F10 switches; R gets on or off the train beside you.
hint.zh: 第一人称下镜头放到你的人物身后（插件旁边的 nimby3d_avatar.vrm，你自己的 VRM 模型）。C 键或 Shift+F10 切换；R 键上下旁边的列车。

hint.en: How far behind your figure's head the camera is.
hint.zh: 镜头离人物头部多远。

name.zh: 走路速度（米/秒，第一人称）

hint.en: The pan keys walk this fast in the first and third person; the wheel only zooms there.
hint.zh: 第一、第三人称里平移键走这么快；滚轮在那里只管缩放。

name.zh: 跑步速度（米/秒，按住 Shift）

hint.en: Holding Shift with the pan keys: running (more than about 10 m/s is not a run but a glide).
hint.zh: 按住 Shift 再按平移键就是跑（超过约 10 米/秒就不是跑而是滑行了）。

hint.en: Draw your figure (nimby3d_avatar.vrm) where you stand in the first person, and its shadow; off: the third person shows no one.
hint.zh: 在第一人称所站的地方画出你的人物（nimby3d_avatar.vrm）和它的影子；关掉后第三人称看不到人。

hint.en: How fast dragging with the middle button turns and tilts the view.
hint.zh: 按住中键拖动时视角转动和俯仰的快慢。

hint.en: How low F8 tilts the view when it switches to 3D.
hint.zh: 按 F8 进入三维时视角压多低。

name.en: Raise the view when zoomed out

hint.en: From 1.5 km half width; at least 55 degrees at 60 km.
hint.zh: 视野半宽 1.5 公里起抬高，60 公里时至少 55 度。

hint.en: The 3D view glides while the pan keys move it.
hint.zh: 按平移键时三维镜头平滑跟随。

name.en: Mouse and keys follow the 3D view
name.zh: 鼠标和按键跟随三维视角

hint.en: Clicks, hovers and pan keys act on what you see. Off: the game gets them untouched.
hint.zh: 点击、悬停和平移键作用在看到的地方。关闭则原样交给游戏。

hint.en: Off: only dragging with the right button follows the 3D view.
hint.zh: 关闭则只有右键拖动跟随三维视角。

hint.en: Where the view is, read from the game's memory: works anywhere in the world.
hint.zh: 从游戏内存里读视野位置：全世界任何地方都能定位。

hint.en: Time of day from the toolbar's clock. Off: a day every 12 minutes (hold F9 to run it).
hint.zh: 时间取自工具栏的时钟。关闭则 12 分钟一天（按住 F9 快进）。

hint.en: The sun's path and the season (snow, insects). The game's own date cannot be read yet.
hint.zh: 决定太阳轨迹和季节（积雪、虫鸣）。游戏里的日期还读不出来。

name.en: Time zone of the game clock

hint.en: Hours from UTC. Auto: by the longitude, with summer time.
hint.zh: 相对 UTC 的小时数。自动：按经度，含夏令时。

hint.en: Trains, cars, birds, water, wind and rain in 3D (Ctrl+Shift+F9).
hint.zh: 三维下的火车、汽车、鸟、水、风雨声（Ctrl+Shift+F9）。

hint.en: F12 also writes the frame to nimby3d_dumps (for reporting problems).
hint.zh: 按 F12 截图时同时写入 nimby3d_dumps（排查问题用）。
